scenes.headline: How a harness turns a model into an agent
scenes.sub: The loop, the tools, file-backed memory, and a self-improving outer loop.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Taffy! A base model only predicts tokens. Everything an agent does happens in the harness around it. Here's how that works.

scenes.text: The harness around a model, its loop, tools, context policy and evaluator, seems to matter as much as its raw intelligence.
scenes.mark: as much as its raw intelligence
scenes.say: The idea: the harness around a model seems to matter as much as the model's raw intelligence.

steps.say: A goal goes into model inference. The model only ever emits text: a final answer, or a tool call.
The harness executes every tool call, bash, grep or edit, behind a permission layer the model can't talk its way past.
The result returns as an observation for the next step. Plan, execute, test, improve, and go again.
And the harness owns control flow. It decides when the goal is met and the loop exits.

left.title: Carry everything in context
items: Logs, diffs and traces keep piling up
Past the window, early details are lost
left.say: Carry every log and diff in the prompt, and a long task overflows the window. Early details quietly disappear.

right.title: Keep durable state in files
items: Context stays a bounded working set
History waits on disk, found with grep
Saved outputs let a run restart
right.say: Keep durable state in files instead. Context stays small, and history waits on disk for grep.

scenes.title: The self-improving outer loop
scenes.say: Can the agent improve its own harness?

items.say: Run the current harness on tasks, and cluster the failures in its traces.
Propose edits, like validate before concluding, or a loop-breaker.
Keep only the edits that pass a regression test, and go again.

scenes.title: Darwin Gödel Machine
scenes.note: STOP made weaker models worse: the base model must be capable
scenes.say: Searching over scaffolds can work: discovered agents went from twenty to fifty percent on SWE-bench. But another method made weaker models worse.

scenes.text: Agent quality depends on the loop, tools, context policy and evaluator around the model, and that's ordinary systems engineering.

recap: The harness runs the plan, act, observe loop
Durable state lives in files, not context
An outer loop can improve the harness
scenes.say: To recap: a loop the harness controls, state kept in files, and an outer loop that tests its own edits.
